subject: Archaeology
title: Shinichi Fujimura: Japan's God Hand
description: A quick win: understand Shinichi Fujimura: Japan's God Hand.

hook.text: A Japanese archaeologist discovered one stunning site after another for 30 years. His colleagues called him 'God Hand.'

buildup.text: Shinichi Fujimura pushed Japan's human occupation back to 700,000 years. Textbooks were rewritten.

discovery.text: In 2000, a newspaper photographer hid a camera and filmed Fujimura burying artifacts at a site before the official.

twist.text: He had planted fake artifacts at dozens of sites over three decades.

climax.text: Fujimura confessed and blamed mental illness. His fabrications affected 180 sites and erased decades of published.

punchline.text: God Hand was caught on camera. Thirty years of faked history crumbled.

quiz.question: How was Shinichi Fujimura caught?
options: Radiocarbon dating proved his artifacts were modern
A newspaper photographer secretly filmed him burying artifacts before excavation
A rival archaeologist found the same type of artifact for sale online
